text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, Mejiro Ardan is shocked to 
accidentally learn that Sakura Chiyono O 
is contemplating retiring from racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While on hiatus due to injury, Sakura 
Chiyono O despairingly felt that the gap 
between herself and Mejiro Ardan had grown 
too wide, and that she would never be able 
to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To her, who lamented that there was no 
longer any point in returning, Mejiro 
Ardan asked her to watch her battle 
against Yaeno Muteki in the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are rivals, one can 
transcend limits time and again and grow 
boundlessly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To convey that truth to Sakura Chiyono O 
through her running, Mejiro Ardan felt a 
fire blaze within her heart...!
